title: Cetanā
text: 1-8 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpasañcetanāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe || Yo dhammasañcetanāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe || jarā{maraṇassa} pātubhāvo || || 9-14 Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpasañcetanāya nirodho vūpasamo || pe || Yo dhammasañcetanāya nirodho vūpasamo || jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || ||
